analysis_strategy.summary: Analyze the pinned Hello-World repository as a deliberately tiny external fixture. The only source evidence is README line 1, so the final report must be concise, decision-oriented and explicit about what cannot be inferred.
analysis_strategy.whole_repo_first_plan: Cover the full included source inventory first: the repository contains a single README file with one visible statement. Do not infer runtime behavior, interfaces, architecture, security posture or delivery process beyond that evidence.

tier_plan.tier1: Create one file card for README and preserve the exact evidence line.
tier_plan.tier2: No broader source-family synthesis is justified beyond a documentation-only fixture family.
tier_plan.tier3: No deep flow or interface slice is justified because no runtime source, contract, tests or configuration exist.
tier_plan.tier4: Use the final report to make a narrow keep-or-extend decision with explicit limitations.

candidate_source_slices.name: README-only fixture
candidate_source_slices.why_it_matters: The single README line is the full evidence basis and should prevent invented functionality.

skill_workbench_not_planned.reason: A skill workbench would create fake depth for a one-line README-only repository.

report_intent.decision_focus: Confirm that the repository is only a tiny hello-world fixture and should not be presented as a product system.

analysis_coverage.summary: The strategy inspected the single included source file.

inspected_files.reason: Only source file in the pinned external repository.
